MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Dot fits the Alexa and Fire TV devices I already use, so its connection to my home setup makes sense, although I do not currently need a separate speaker.",
    "The microSD card relates to my recent interest in recording video, making it potentially useful if its specifications match my camera and I need more storage."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The HD and previous-generation Fire TV sticks duplicate functions I already have through my 4K stick and Fire TV television, without giving me a clear reason to add another device.",
    "The earbuds, portable speaker and older tablet do not support a current need suggested by my home video and security purchases.",
    "Wi-Fi extenders could help connected cameras if coverage were poor, but owning cameras alone does not mean I have a signal problem. The drive enclosure likewise assumes a storage project I do not have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to suggest more Amazon devices, even when they repeat capabilities I already own.",
    "My interest in cameras and home electronics seems to have been stretched into a broad interest in electronic accessories, regardless of whether they solve a current problem."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: another streaming device needs a clear additional use or upgrade to interest me.",
    "My recent purchases point toward home viewing, security and video recording, rather than personal listening or general gadget shopping.",
    "Accessories need a specific purpose and confirmed compatibility; possible usefulness alone is not enough for me to choose them now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my connected home and video interests, but often treated related devices as current needs without accounting for what I already own or what an accessory would actually help me do."
}
